lines.text: Day three of Jake's park road trip, a storm closed the trail he had driven nine hours to hike.
Every night after that was booked somewhere else, so he had to drive on without it.
Plan one loose day every few days, with no booking you can't move.
Keep a rainy-day plan for each park, like a visitor center or a scenic drive,
and check the park's alerts on nps.gov each morning.
